title: G5: Symmetry reduction via Aut(H) and the exact final isomorphism count

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Gap G5.** The final deliverable is the exact COUNT and complete list of distinct geodetic graphs of diameter $\ge2$ homeomorphic to $H$. Distinct $x$-solutions in the same $\mathrm{Aut}(H)$-orbit yield ISOMORPHIC $G'$ and must not be double counted. $\mathrm{Aut}(H)=\mathrm{P\Sigma U}(3,5)$ has order 252000 and acts on $E(H)$ (edge-transitively), hence on the variable vector $(x_e)$.

Must: (i) describe the action on the solution set; (ii) apply Burnside/orbit-counting, correctly handling fixed points of each group element on the constraint/solution set; (iii) report the exact number of orbits (= number of non-isomorphic geodetic homeomorphs) and exhibit a representative of each. Edge-transitivity already constrains symmetric (constant-$x_e$) solution families and should be exploited.
